author: kitkatkela88
body:
I've seen some of my favorites mentioned already, so I'll add a few new ones:

(1) Punjabi Tandoor in Anaheim (across from the Packing House) - the best Chana Masala and Lamb Vindaloo ever. Family run business with multiple locations but I've only ever been to the one in Anaheim.

(2) Mi Rak Korean BBQ in Fullerton (in the same strip mall as Arirang Market, but around the bend facing Brookhurst) - despite the BBQ title, we love going for their cold noodles. I especially like their combo Cold Buckwheat Noodles + Bulgogi, and their Buckwheat Noodles in Cold White Bean Soup. Their Black Goat Stew is also a signature dish and one of the best I've ever had. The ladies there have seen me grow up, get married, and have a baby in the past almost two decades. Great people.

(3) Hickory & Spice BBQ in Orange - newish American BBQ from a few years ago, but really good bbq spot. Classic American bbq, with great beef brisket and pulled pork sandwiches.

(4) Carolina's in Garden Grove (south of Disneyland) - love this family style Italian place. Huge portions and the staff is always so friendly and welcoming. Everything is great on their menu but my favorite is the cheese tortellini and basic alfredo. Beats Olive Garden, hands down.

(5) Olive Pit in Brea - bougie Mediterranean, but sooo yummy! My fav is the Lamb Chop Plate.

(6) The Green Olive Mediterranean Cuisine in Long Beach - as the name states, this Mediterranean place is just very straightforward and a more affordable price point than the Olive Pit above. But it's tasty, super filling, with great service, and friendly staff.

(7) Super Juicy Dumpling in Brea (by the Walmart) - legit Chinese-run dim sim/dumpling house. No shade, but since it's truly Chinese you get culture bombed in their little space. The Xio Long Baos are so soupy and perfect, and their family style dishes are huge and plentiful to share.

(8) Omeli Kitchen in Fullerton - Hole in the wall Vietnamese restaurant with some of the best Beef Rib Pho, Lomo Saltado, Garlic Noodles, and Taro Coffee. I also love that you can order a side of beef pho broth to go with any other dish so you can indulge and never miss out on it. The owner is the sweetest and will come out if it's not too busy to personally make sure you're happy with your meal.

(9) What's Up Japanese Noodles in Fullerton (across the street from Omeli Kitchen, next to gas station) - tiny little ramen shop run by actual Japanese chefs, cooks, and wait staff. We've also been going here for a decade or more now. Super legit ramen and sides. Get the Kuro if you want a deep, salty, Tonkotsu flavor. There's also no limit to their extra noodle order so get your money's worth! My husband peaked at 4 extra noodles once! If you love the food and service, you can buy the cooks some beer and they'll come and cheers with you.

If I think of any more I'll come add them to the list here.
